purpose: Construct working models for revenue/tax, banking/credit, capital formation, ownership, markets, and external income — using Arkansas budget baseline as the NOW bridge, without analyzing every appropriation line.
one_sentence: Arkansas converts production and outside demand into household prosperity and public income by broadening ownership, directing credit to local assets, pricing use/impact/external surplus rather than ordinary wages and homes, and blocking extraction pathways that leak capital and purchase political power.

budget_bridge.discipline: Establish funding today → major revenue dependencies → major expenditure flows → growth/shrink patterns → capability/assets vs recurring consumption → what CC must eventually replace or restructure. Fascinating nonessentials → Stage 3.

countable_discipline.rule: ILLUSTRATIVE and WORKING models are not COUNTABLE replacement dollars

open.note: Prosperity Fund / engine feeders remain COUNTABLE $0 — architecture holds; dollars gated
State antitrust reach vs federal preemption for concentrated sectors

closed_or_absorbed_this_pass.note: Public banking / local equity forms — working mechanism stated in ME-02; statute remains Stage 4

modules.name: Revenue & tax replacement
modules.now: Arkansas General Revenue distributed to agencies/institutions is ~$6.494B in FY2026 Allocation A (~+2.9% YoY). State finance still leans on taxes and federal flows that ultimately load ordinary households and employers; prosperity-linked replacement engines are not yet countable cash.
modules.problem: Taxing ordinary labor income and homeownership punishes work and rootedness while under-capturing external demand, resource rents, enterprise surplus, and publicly created land/value gains.
modules.future_state: Core public goods funded primarily by diversified prosperity and external-income engines so ordinary wages and ordinary homes can exit the compulsory base after replacement cash is earned and reserved.
modules.mechanism: Ten-engine Public Income model feeding State and Community Prosperity Revenue Ledgers; Tax Retirement / Prosperity Fund ring-fence; Residual Wealth Contribution only as last self-retiring shock absorber on substantial surplus wealth by beneficial ownership — never ordinary labor income. No abolish-today.
modules.money_flow: Engine cash → reserved ledgers → services and asset-building appropriations → residual only if engines underperform after gates. Leakage: capture of a single engine or premature tax abolition.
modules.ownership: Public/community claim on surplus tied to public contribution and external demand; households keep ordinary wage and home bases as engines clear.
modules.household_effect: Lower compulsory burden on wages/homes over time; services continue without austerity if Dependency Rule holds.
modules.government_role: Authorize engines, ring-fence retirement fund, publish incidence, refuse COUNTABLE claims without free cash.
modules.market_role: Firms price use/impact/depletion where designed; competition remains; no single-tax monopoly on the replacement base.
modules.transition: Build bridges (engines + reserves) before removing old roads (IIT/property). Dual abolition fails Base@16y in prior stack — sequence by earned capacity.
modules.risks: Political pressure to cut taxes before cash clears; regressive single-swap; elite capture of residual design.
modules.measurement: Share of GR replaced by reserved engine cash; household incidence by income band; COUNTABLE vs ILLUSTRATIVE ledger.
modules.evidence_status: WORKING — architecture and demotion discipline locked; COUNTABLE NOW $0
modules.deferred_validation: Feeder free-cash binds; microsim incidence; Stage 4 recession/revenue sensitivity

modules.name: Banking & credit
modules.now: Arkansas households and firms access credit mainly through private banks, credit unions, and nonbank lenders; interest and return often leave the community. Public capital vehicles for local productive credit are thin relative to need.
modules.problem: Credit creation and interest flows extract value to distant balance sheets; local production does not reliably compound into local productive assets.
modules.future_state: Productive credit is available for households, farms, and firms; savings/pensions/public capital reinvest into Arkansas capacity with geographic return disclosure.
modules.mechanism: Community/regional banking and credit-union pathways; public/quasi-public capital vehicles; separate payment utility from speculative leverage; pension/local-reinvestment rules that respect fiduciary duty; disclosure of where interest flows.
modules.money_flow: Deposits and public capital → productive loans/equity → local assets → retained interest/returns → recycled credit. Leakage: out-of-state ownership of loan books and fee extraction.
modules.ownership: Who owns banks, funds, and claims on interest is explicit; community equity forms preferred where legal.
modules.household_effect: Affordable productive credit; fewer debt traps; less interest leakage from the household ledger.
modules.government_role: Charter/enable community vehicles; disclosure mandates; do not socialize speculative losses.
modules.market_role: Private lenders compete on productive terms; public options as yardstick where access fails.
modules.transition: Expand community credit capacity before restricting extractive products; no overnight public monopoly bank.
modules.risks: Federal banking conflicts; fiduciary challenges; capture of public vehicle by connected borrowers.
modules.measurement: Local loan/deposit ratios; interest retained in-state; small-business and farm credit access.
modules.evidence_status: WORKING — FDIC/community-bank binds partial; legal form open
modules.deferred_validation: Arkansas-legal public equity forms; Stage 4 credit-crunch stress

modules.name: Capital formation & Prosperity Fund
modules.now: Arkansas lacks a large ring-fenced public prosperity capital stock dedicated to replacing labor/home taxes and compounding local productive assets. FY2026 GR grows ~3% but remains an operating appropriation machine more than an asset-builder.
modules.problem: Current surplus (private and public) does not systematically become future Arkansas productive assets under public/community claim.
modules.future_state: A Prosperity Fund accumulates reserved engine and enterprise returns into productive assets that generate future public income and household opportunity.
modules.mechanism: Tax Retirement / Prosperity Fund ring-fence; capitalize from cleared engine free cash and public equity returns; invest under rules favoring Arkansas capacity, broad ownership, and disclosed geographic returns.
modules.money_flow: Cleared engine cash + public equity returns → Fund → productive assets → dividends/fees → ledgers and reinvestment. Forbidden: raiding Fund for ordinary operating convenience.
modules.ownership: Fund held in public/community trust form; beneficial claim is statewide/community, not private sponsors.
modules.household_effect: Indirect: better services and lower future tax burden; direct: co-investment and ownership pathways where designed.
modules.government_role: Fiduciary stewardship, investment rules, anti-raid locks, public reporting.
modules.market_role: Co-invest with private capital under ownership and anti-extraction covenants.
modules.transition: Fund grows as engines clear — capitalization not assumed from COUNTABLE $0.
modules.risks: Empty Fund used as political symbol; bad investments; capture of investment board.
modules.measurement: Fund NAV; Arkansas share of assets; income to ledgers; raid attempts blocked.
modules.evidence_status: WORKING — structure locked; capitalization gated by COUNTABLE $0
modules.deferred_validation: Investment policy; legal trust form; Stage 4 drawdown stress

modules.name: Labor → ownership ladder
modules.now: Most Arkansas workers earn wages without ownership stakes, portable benefits, or a clear path from employee → owner → local employer.
modules.problem: Wage-only dependence fails household security and keeps surplus concentrating with absentee owners.
modules.future_state: Workers can earn, own, start, and grow enterprises that keep surplus local — income + assets + time.
modules.mechanism: ESOP/co-op/employee-ownership pathways; portable benefits architecture; small-business credit (ME-02); procurement preference (GO-06); anti-noncompete/mobility where Arkansas law allows; public IP share proportional to public contribution.
modules.money_flow: Enterprise returns → workers/owners → local reinvestment; public share of publicly created IP returns → ledgers/Fund.
modules.ownership: Broad worker and local-owner stakes; reduce PE/absentee strip-mining of Arkansas firms.
modules.household_effect: Assets and voice at work; portable security; entrepreneurship optionality.
modules.government_role: Enable ownership forms, credit, procurement, IP-share rules; do not micromanage every firm.
modules.market_role: Private formation and competition remain primary; ownership design changes who captures surplus.
modules.transition: Pilot ownership conversions and formation supports before mandating sector-wide forms.
modules.risks: Token ownership without control; failed co-ops; regulatory conflict on benefits.
modules.measurement: Employee-owned firm share; business formation; household asset participation.
modules.evidence_status: WORKING — BDS/formation binds partial; pilot site unlocked
modules.deferred_validation: Rural vs metro ownership form mix; Stage 4 automation under HYP-134 quarantine

modules.name: Markets & competition
modules.now: Key Arkansas sectors (food processing, retail, healthcare, finance) face concentration and extraction risks; market power converts into political influence.
modules.problem: Monopoly, PE strip-mining, franchise extraction, and absentee ownership drain local wealth and rewrite rules.
modules.future_state: Markets remain competitive and innovative while anti-extraction rules and ownership incentives produce broad prosperity.
modules.mechanism: Sector-aware competition policy; public-option/yardstick where natural monopoly or capture is chronic; franchise/PE disclosure and anti-extraction covenants for public benefits; procurement for competitive local suppliers; ownership incentives (ME-04).
modules.money_flow: Competitive pricing retains surplus in households and local firms; extraction fees and monopoly rents are the leakage to block.
modules.ownership: Prefer distributed productive ownership; disclose beneficial owners for firms taking public benefits.
modules.household_effect: Fairer prices and wages; more local supplier options.
modules.government_role: Set market rules and yardsticks; enforce disclosure; avoid captured industrial policy.
modules.market_role: Primary discovery and production mechanism under anti-extraction rules — not laissez-faire extraction.
modules.transition: Target highest-extraction sectors first; coordinate with federal antitrust where state reach ends.
modules.risks: Federal preemption; protectionism dressed as competition; captured public options.
modules.measurement: Concentration indices by sector; local supplier share; price/wage outcomes.
modules.deferred_validation: Arkansas concentration atlas; Stage 4 legal boundaries

modules.name: External income capture
modules.now: Arkansas earns substantial outside demand (e.g., tourism spend scale is real in prior binds) but public capture mechanisms often leave COUNTABLE replacement cash at $0; dedicated fees are frequently already pledged.
modules.problem: Outside dollars circulate or exit without reserved public/community claim sufficient to fund tax retirement.
modules.future_state: External demand contributes reserved free cash to prosperity ledgers via ownership/participation mechanisms — not wishful fee stacking.
modules.mechanism: Scored capture paths (ownership, participation, ground lease, energy equity, processing margins) prioritized by free-cash and incidence gates; food-hub pathway remains high-potential but COUNTABLE $0 with facility validation as implementation gate.
modules.money_flow: Outside spend/investment → Arkansas production → reserved public/community share → ledgers/Fund. Leakage: absentee processing and tourist-fee shells with no free cash.
modules.ownership: Capture prefers ownership/participation over pure tax on visitors when cash is already dedicated.
modules.household_effect: Services funded without raising household wage/home taxes; local jobs in retained processing.
modules.government_role: Design capture mechanisms; refuse COUNTABLE promotion without audited free cash.
modules.market_role: Private tourism, processing, energy, and advanced sectors operate; public share is contractual/ownership-based where designed.
modules.transition: Bind mechanisms before claiming replacement dollars; Dependency Rule on any fee redesign.
modules.risks: Double-counting dedicated fees; capacity-gate violations (HYP-130); overclaiming tourism.
modules.measurement: Reserved free cash by mechanism; COUNTABLE ledger; leakage rate on external spend.
modules.deferred_validation: Next feeder binds only when architecture requires; Stage 4 stress

modules.name: Public income engines stack
modules.now: Ten-engine model is architecturally locked; feeder-binding demotions hold COUNTABLE NOW at $0. Illustrative long-run stacks exist and must not be misread as current cash.
modules.problem: Without a diversified engine stack, tax retirement collapses into a single fragile base or austerity.
modules.future_state: Many small mechanisms + productive public wealth + narrow residual wealth fund public goods with published confidence labels.
modules.mechanism: Engines: Use, Impact, Depletion, Visitor, Luxury, Human-capital, Value Capture, Enterprise, Prosperity Fund, External Income — each gated by free cash and incidence; residual wealth last.
modules.money_flow: Each engine → reserved ledger lines → services/Fund. Aggregation rules forbid treating ILLUSTRATIVE as COUNTABLE.
modules.ownership: Engine claims are public/community; incidence must not recreate wage/home taxation by another name.
modules.household_effect: Stable services; protected ordinary bases; transparent who pays.
modules.government_role: Operate ledgers; demote failed feeders; publish confidence badges.
modules.market_role: Respond to priced externalities and use where engines apply.
modules.transition: Grow cleared engines; never swap bases overnight.
modules.risks: Illustrative inflation; political cherry-picking of regressive engines.
modules.measurement: Per-engine COUNTABLE; demotion log; replacement share of GR.
modules.evidence_status: STRONG on discipline / WORKING on cash — COUNTABLE $0
modules.deferred_validation: Per-engine Stage 4 attack; unabridged engine chapters in Stage 3

modules.name: Capital retention & leakage
modules.now: Arkansas money enters via wages, transfers, enterprise, and outside demand, then often leaks through absentee profits, interest, processing margins, and imported consumer goods. Geographic Money Statements are not yet operational.
modules.problem: Internal circulation without retention does not build household or community capital.
modules.future_state: Every major proposal shows retention vs leakage; communities can see where surplus stays or exits.
modules.mechanism: Money River accounting: entry → local circulation → Arkansas assets vs outward leak; Ownership Flow and procurement/ownership rules reduce leak; Geographic Money Statements (Stage 2.5/2.6 deepen).
modules.money_flow: Entry → wages/purchases → firm surplus → owner geography decides retain vs leak → public claim where designed.
modules.ownership: Owner geography is the primary retention switch; broad local ownership is the structural fix.
modules.household_effect: More local multipliers; fewer extractive price/wage squeezes.
modules.government_role: Measure and disclose; prefer ownership/procurement designs that retain; avoid fake buy-local theater.
modules.market_role: Trade continues; retention is about who owns Arkansas production, not autarky.
modules.transition: Measure first; change ownership/credit/procurement next; do not blockade trade.
modules.risks: Protectionism; bad multipliers; data gaps faking precision.
modules.measurement: Leakage ratio; local ownership share; interest retained.
modules.evidence_status: WORKING — schematic V1; county map SPEC_ONLY until data layer
modules.deferred_validation: Geographic Money Statements; Capital Map population
